title: Saddam Hussein to Cookie Monster in four real photos
description: Four real photos connect Iraq's Saddam Hussein to Cookie Monster from Sesame Street, through a defense secretary, a president and a first lady.
hook: How is Saddam Hussein connected to Cookie Monster?

links.line: In 1983, Saddam Hussein shook hands with Donald Rumsfeld, sent to Baghdad as Reagan's special envoy.

image.file: File:Bush and Rumsfeld shakes hands, November 8, 2006.jpg

links.line: In 2006, after leading the Pentagon through the Iraq War, Rumsfeld resigned as George W. Bush's defense secretary.
In 2008, days after the election, Bush welcomed Barack and Michelle Obama to the White House.

image.file: File:Jill Biden and Michelle Obama pose with some of the cast of Sesame Street, 2011.jpg

links.line: And in 2011, Michelle Obama posed on stage with Cookie Monster at an event for military families in Ohio.
